products.description: UTG Picatinny rail for optics mounting Allows you to offset a red dot by 45° for rapid target acquisition while retaining your main optic. Model: 45 DEGREE INCLINED PICATINNY RAIL The UTG 45° inclined Picatinny rail is designed to install a Docter standard red dot on a weapon equipped with a Picatinny rail. Its 45 degree angle allows you to quickly switch between a primary optic and a secondary sight, offering an instantaneous transition depending on the shooting distance or the type of target. Its robust design guarantees reliable mounting and optimal retention of the optic. The UTG support constitutes an ideal solution for sports shooters wishing to complete their configuration with an offset red dot. Compatible with optics using the Docter footprint, it attaches easily to a standard Picatinny rail and offers excellent rigidity. Its 45° angle allows a quick change of aim without modifying its shooting position, an asset appreciated in dynamic and sports shooting.

products.name: MTS AR500 Steel Target Hit Indicator
products.title: MTS My Tactical Solutions - Indicateur d'impact MTS AR500 Steel Target Hit Indicator
products.description: MTS My Tactical Solutions Model: AR500 Steel Target Hit Indicator Instantly visualize your long-distance hits thanks to a powerful light signal triggered with each hit on your steel target. The MTS AR500 Steel Target Hit Indicator is designed to provide immediate visual confirmation of an impact on a metal target. Its system detects the vibrations caused by the projectile and triggers 10 high-intensity green LEDs, considerably facilitating the identification of hits when the distance makes the sound or movement of the target difficult to perceive. The device is suitable for the majority of steel targets over 5 inches (12.7 cm) and is easily attached using a robust hook-and-loop system. Powered by 3 AA batteries (not included) it offers a claimed autonomy of more than 30,000 impact detections. Its sensitivity makes it possible to detect low energy impacts, with the manufacturer announcing in particular the detection of a .223 caliber impact up to 1,000 yards (approximately 914 meters). External dimensions (in cm): 6 x 9 Weight (in g): 90 Features: 10 flashing LED lights warn the shooter of an impact

products.name: Stock - B&T USW chassis for Glock /17/19/19x/34/45 (gen.3-4-5)
products.title: BRUGGER & THOMET - Crosse - chassis B&T USW pour Glock /17/19/19x/34/45 (gén.3-4-5)
products.description: B&TChassis - B&T USW-G17 stock for Glock: The concept of putting a stock on a handgun, to improve its practical precision, has existed for more than a century. In recent years, various systems have appeared that can be adapted to modern pistols. B&T ended up designing its own version under the name USW, derived from the principle of its USW-A1 pistol but adapted to more common weapons. With an extraordinary finish, the whole thing is made mainly of aeronautical aluminum and polymer. For the first time when using this type of accessory, we did not notice any significant traces after assembly/disassembly on the carcass of the weapon (no scratches, no marks, unlike other competing products), which demonstrates the quality of this production (excellent geometry and absence of sharp edges on the contact zones). A dial at the front allows you to tension the system which is supported behind the beaver tail and at the front of the trigger guard. The advantage of this system is that the tension is done in the longitudinal axis and not by lateral compression, therefore the reliability of the weapon is not affected.

products.name: Weight for MDT QD M-LOK Gen 3 handguard
products.title: MDT - Poids pour garde main MDT QD M-LOK Gen 3
products.description: MDT Model: MDT QD M-LOK GEN 3 EXTERIOR HANDGUARD WEIGHTS – 2 PACK Optimize the balance of your rifle and reduce felt recoil with these MDT M-LOK exterior weights with integrated QD attachment. MDT M-LOK QD external weights provide a simple and modular solution for adjusting the weight distribution of a rifle. Strategically placed on the handguard, they move the point of balance and increase the stability of the weapon. The increase in mass also helps reduce felt recoil and makes it easier to observe your own impacts through optics. Made from case-hardened 1018 steel with a nitrided finish, these weights are designed for intensive use. Their M-LOK mounting allows them to be installed, moved or removed depending on the desired configuration. They are compatible with frames and stocks with suitable M-LOK slots. Color: Black Weight (in g): 320

products.description: MDT Model: MDT M-LOK ADJUSTABLE THUMB REST An adjustable and ergonomic thumb rest allowing you to find a constant and comfortable hand position to improve control of your rifle. Made of high-strength polymer, the MDT adjustable thumb rest constitutes a compact accessory allowing you to personalize the ergonomics of a rifle equipped with M-LOK interfaces. Thanks to its angular adjustment, the shooter can determine the position that suits him in order to obtain a more natural hand placement and above all reproducible from one shot to another. Its pronounced texture provides effective support to the thumb and helps maintain a regular grip.Compatibility: standard M-LOK locationMaterial: high-strength polymerProminence once installed: 1" (approximately 2.54 cm) Color: Black

products.name: Side screw for MDT adjustment busk for ORYX chassis (set of 2)
products.title: MDT - Vis latéral pour busc réglage MDT pour chassis ORYX (lot de 2)
products.description: MDT Model: ORYX BUTTSTOCK ADJUSTMENT KNOBS Quickly adjust the height of the buttstock of your ORYX stock without any tools. Lateral adjustment screws designed to allow tool-free adjustment of the height of the MDT ORYX stock cheekpiece. They facilitate changes in the position of the cheek piece, particularly when several shooters use the same rifle or when the thickness of clothing varies. Color: black Packaging: 2 side adjustment screws for busk The MDT ORYX adjustment screws allow you to easily and quickly adjust the height of the busk without using a tool. This solution is particularly practical when the rifle is used by several shooters requiring different adjustments or to adapt the position of the cheek piece according to the equipment and clothing worn. The tool-free adjustment also makes it easier to lower or remove the nosepiece when it is necessary to remove the slide for cleaning the weapon or for certain optics adjustment operations. MDT particularly recommends this accessory for Savage Mk II .22 LR rifles mounted on ORYX chassis, the breech of which may be obstructed by the cheekpiece when removing it.

This solution makes it possible to refine the ergonomics of a compatible MDT stock without replacing the entire stock. products.name: MDT adjustable butt plate for XRS chassis - ORYX
products.title: MDT - Plaque de couche réglable MDT pour chassis XRS - ORYX
products.description: MDT Model: VERTICAL ADJUSTMENT BUTTPAD Perfectly optimize the support of your rifle on the shoulder thanks to a butt plate adjustable vertically, horizontally and in inclination. The MDT Vertical Adjustment Buttpad is an adjustable butt pad designed to improve ergonomics and positioning of the rifle on the shoulder. It allows the position of the butt plate to be precisely adjusted in height, laterally as well as in inclination in order to adapt it to the morphology and shooting position of the shooter. The vertical adjustment offers an amplitude of 52 mm upwards and 17 mm downwards compared to the neutral position. The horizontal displacement reaches 14 mm in total, or 7 mm on each side, while the inclination can be adjusted up to 13°. Made from 6061-T6 aluminum, it constitutes a particularly interesting improvement for obtaining a more natural and reproducible placement of the rifle. Its installation adds 14.5 mm to the stock length (LOP). It is compatible with MDT XRS, HNT26 and ORYX frames, as well as MDT SRS-X Lite, SRS-Lite, SCS-Lite and CCS stocks. products.title: CREPIN LEBLOND - Livre "A la découverte du tir à la carabine Handisport - Malvoyant"
products.description: CREPIN LEBLOND Model: Discovering rifle shooting Handisport - Visually impaired 78 pages Author: Renée Cicorella-Charbonnier Handisport was created by neurosurgeon Ludwig Guttman initially with a therapeutic objective for the rehabilitation of disabled people. Ludwig Guttman was the director of Stoke Mandeville Hospital near London which treated paraplegic World War II veterans. To promote their rehabilitation in a fun way, sports games were organized: basketball and archery among others. These “Stoke Mandeville games”, organized in 1948, gave birth to the Paralympic Games in 1960. Disabled sports quickly became a leisure activity and then a competitive one. In 1989, the International Paralympic Committee brought together all sports structures for disabled people. A disabled sport is a sport whose rules have been adapted so that it can be practiced by people with a physical or sensory disability. To practice this sport, you need either a disabled sports club or in a stand of the French Shooting Federation. products.description: CREPIN LEBLOND Model: Submachine guns from around the world 256 pagesAuthor: Jean HuonThe first submachine guns were developed during the Great War. After 1918, the weapon was of only moderate interest to the soldiers who did not understand its usefulness, with the exception of "cleaning" trenches. Several conflicts, such as the Chaco War or the Spanish Civil War, nevertheless allow us to measure its capabilities. Things changed at the start of the Second World War when the Germans made massive use of submachine guns. As the conflict evolved, differentiated armament became essential. We are then witnessing the creation of new simple models, easy to manufacture in large numbers and at a moderate cost. From 1945 to the end of the 20th century, submachine guns were modernized, but they sometimes disappeared from military equipment in favor of assault rifles. New models are developed, with advanced technology, they are mainly used by law enforcement or special units. A well-balanced rifle provides more stability and control, allowing you to stay on target, observe impacts and quickly make follow-up shots if necessary. A maximum of 3 pairs can be installed in a rear stock. Each package contains one pair, with a total weight of 140 g. This adjustment improves general stability, speed of target acquisition and allows better control of the weapon when firing, particularly with heavy configurations at the front (equipped handguard, bipod, accessories, etc.). Assembly is carried out directly in the locations provided inside the stock, without modification.

products.description: WALTHER Model: BWK 1 - Blue Wood Knife Blade size (cm): 9.4 Folding knife Blade material (steel): 440 C Closed length: 123 mm Handle material: walnut wood Double locking Total length (cm): 21.7 (Open) Weight (in g): 95 Delivered with leather sheath The Walther BWK 1 is the first in the series of Walther's Blue Wood Knives. These knives look like they were made for the outdoors, and they prove it every day. The WK 1 has an ergonomically shaped walnut handle and, true to its name, a blued lining. The textured handle with finger recesses and pleasant width gives you a good grip in all kinds of weather conditions. The 440C steel gray titanium drop point blade has a reliable liner lock that is ideal for outdoor use. The knife comes with a high quality leather sheath for safe transport.

products.name: WALTHER BWK 4 folding knife - Blue Wood Knife
products.title: WALTHER - Couteau pliant WALTHER BWK 4 - Blue Wood Knife
products.description: WALTHER Model: BWK 4 - Blue Wood Knife Blade size (cm): 9.4 Folding knifeBlade material (steel): 440 CLength closed: 133 mmHandle material: walnut woodDouble lock Total length (cm): 22.5 (Open) Weight (in g): 172 Delivered with leather sheath An outdoor knife with a tanto blade? Does this make sense? That's for sure, and the Walther BWK 4 is proof of that. A member of the Walther Blue Wood Knives family of knives, this knife with a tanto blade held between two walnut handle scales is an ideal companion for outdoor adventures. The blade is made of 440 steel, with a titanium gray coating for durability. On the spine of the 94mm blade there is a nail rest and a thumb rest. The liner lock holds the blade in place and a black universal pivot screw allows you to adjust the movement of the blade even with a coin. The textured surface and perfectly shaped finger recesses ensure that the Walther BWK 4 will not slip out of your hand in any weather. The blued lining joins the blade with the handle scales.

ECOSTRIKE™ makes the impossible possible. To make the bullet lighter and prevent it from fragmenting, the lead has been replaced by copper and nickel. With ECOSTRIKE™ begins a new era, where the feeling of being one with nature reaches new heights. The bullet and its characteristics take into account the caliber of the weapon, the game, the environment and the preservation of the venison. The ambition of ECOSTRIKE™ is to always ensure a decisive impact, in order to guarantee a memorable hunting experience. ECOSTRIKE™ has been developed to obtain unrivaled precision in all circumstances. Its controlled expansion and its high residual mass retention ensures regular behavior and deep penetration, at short and long distances. Precision is optimized thanks to a unique design and ultra-precise production methods. The bullet is nickel-plated with a patented process which minimizes barrel fouling.

products.description: NORMA Caliber 9.3x62 Ogive Type: ORYX SILENCER Weight (in g): 18.5 Grains: 286 Speed (in m/s): 715 Energy (in joules): 4731 Packaging: Box of 20 cartridges As the use of a silencer increases in popularity, we see more and more short barrels on the market. But what few people know is that a short barrel significantly reduces the spin and accuracy of the ammunition used. Standard rifle ammunition today is optimized for barrel lengths of 24" while many barrels today are around 50cm. In reality, this means that the difference in length makes it impossible for the powder to burn completely before the bullet leaves the muzzle, significantly shortening the life of silencers and reducing the spin of the ammunition. Features: - Optimized for barrels of approximately 50 cm - Loaded with an ORYX bullet - Reduced muzzle flame - Significantly increases the power and effect of the bullet compared to a standard bullet - Less muzzle pressure: increased life of the suppressors

Regular use of these capsules helps maintain shooting accuracy, reduce premature wear of components and improve the overall functioning of your weapon. Use after approximately 10 standard CO₂ capsules to maintain optimal internal lubrication. products.description: DENIXDenix replica of the famous model 1873 revolver featured in so many westerns. Replica not firing, for decoration only. All moving parts functional. Faithful and quality manufacturing, wood and metal. Realistic dimensions and weight. Reproduction of the 4.75" revolver in metal and wood, with simulation mechanism and firing and rotating drum. The Peacemaker revolver, also known as Single Action Army (from SAA), was designed by Samuel Colt in 1873 and was manufactured with different barrel lengths: the short version of 4.75 inches, the plus forms, 5.5 and 7.5 inches, or the imposing "Buntline Special", 12 inches. This weapon was initially used by the US military However, within a few years, most American citizens picked up one of these revolvers. The fact that it used ammunition of the same caliber as the Winchester M1873 rifle contributed to its popularization as a short gun in the old west of North America in the late 19th century. Aside from the mentioned Peacemaker, it is also known as the Frontier or Widowmaker.

products.description: DENIXReplica of the famous Mauser pistol from 1896In the wide range of short weapons, the C-96 has the honor of bearing the name “classic”, also known as “Broomhandle”. It was a semi-automatic pistol made in Germany from 1896 to 1937, created by the great Peter Paul Mauser. This semi-automatic pistol, with more than a century of history, has an extremely functional and practical design that has led it to be recognized as one of the best weapons in the world. The German army received more than 100,000 units, which it used during World War I, where close-range trench fighting abounded. Communist Russia acquired large quantities of the C-96, a weapon that eventually received the nickname "Bolo-Mauser", meaning the Mauser of the Bolsheviks. When World War II began in 1939, the C-96 was still active. Although no country has recognized it as a regulatory weapon, it was used in all warlike events that occurred in the first half of the 20th century. Weight: 1120 gr Length: 32 cm

The AK-47, an acronym for Avtomat Kalashnikova Model 1947, was designed in 1942 by Mikhail Kalashnikov, a Russian fighter during World War II. The particularity of this rifle is its cartridge reloading system, which uses the force of the combustion gases produced by the shot to facilitate the placement of a new cartridge in the chamber of the weapon and expel the bush already used. In addition, its curved magazine, which gives it greater capacity in a smaller space, is also a distinctive feature. Converted into the official rifle of the USSR between 1947 and 1978, it is currently the most widely used firearm in the world. In 1949, the Red Army adopted it as its primary infantry weapon, replacing the PPSh-41 submachine gun, although it was not until 1954 that it entered widespread service. Thus, the Sten machine gun was born, a weapon with a questionable but reliable design. And also one of the most easily recognizable weapons of World War II. It would eventually be used by airborne troops and special operations forces like the resistance in almost every country occupied by German soldiers. The Stem Mark II was used by Commonwealth forces during World War II and the Korean War. Its most notable features were its simple design and low production cost. The name STEN is an acronym derived from the names of its principal weapons designers: Mayor Reginald Shepherd, Harold Turpin and Enfield, the location of the Royal Small Arms Factory (RSAF) in London. The Minié bullet was a lead bullet cylindrical-conical, of a caliber slightly smaller than that of the barrel of the weapon for which it was intended. It had at its base four outer grooves filled with grease and a conical hole. As designed by Minié, the bullet had an iron lug at its base in order to move it forward and, under the pressure of the gases, to ensure sealing by filling the space between it and the barrel, allowing it to come into contact with its rifling. The ancestor of the Minié bullet was created in 1848 by French army captains Montgomery and Henri-Gustave Delvigne. Their design was made to allow rapid muzzle loading of rifles, an innovation which resulted in its widespread use as a mass battlefield weapon. The Minié bullet was a lead bullet cylindrical-conical, of a caliber slightly smaller than that of the barrel of the weapon for which it was intended. It had at its base four outer grooves filled with grease and a conical hole. As designed by Minié, the bullet had an iron lug at its base in order to move it forward and, under the pressure of the gases, to ensure sealing by filling the space between it and the barrel, allowing it to come into contact with its rifling. The ancestor of the Minié bullet was created in 1848 by French army captains Montgomery and Henri-Gustave Delvigne. Their design was made to allow rapid muzzle loading of rifles, an innovation which resulted in its widespread use as a mass battlefield weapon. products.description: RCBS Model: HAND CASE NECK TURNER Get maximum consistency from your reloaded cartridges by eliminating as many variables as possible. Collar turning involves removing a thin layer of brass from the outside of the case collar in order to obtain a perfectly uniform thickness. The RCBS Hand Case Neck Turner is the ideal tool for this operation. The RCBS Hand Case Neck Turner is designed to machine the exterior of the case neck to give it a consistent thickness. This step is important because most commercially available cases have variations in thickness at the collar. These deviations can lead to problems with collar concentricity and bale runout. By standardizing the collet with the RCBS Manual Collet Turner, you get more consistent and accurate reloaded ammunition. The cutting head uses caliber-specific pilots/mandrels (sold separately) to guide the collet during machining. With its innovative design, the tool allows zero adjustment between the blade and pilot/mandrel, then precisely adjusts the desired thickness of the collar using a micrometer

products.name: RCBS Standard Bullet Extractor #9440

products.description: RCBS Model: RCBS BULLET EXTRACTOR Extract your jacketed projectiles easily and without damaging them thanks to this RCBS bullet extractor compatible with the majority of single-station presses. The RCBS Standard #9440 Bullet Extractor is designed to safely remove jacketed projectiles from reloaded cartridges when you want to correct a powder charge, replace a projectile, or disassemble a cartridge. It mounts on any single-station reloading press equipped with a standard 7/8"-14 thread. Its use requires a clamp (collar) specific to the caliber, sold separately, to ensure an effective grip on the projectile. Compatible with single-station reloading presses with a 7/8"-14 thread. The strength and build quality of this metal funnel are evident from the first use. This is not a universal funnel: the Brass Smith Precision Funnel Set uses precision-machined tips, matched to each caliber, for a perfect fit on the socket neck. The tips are very easy to install and remove with a simple push. The set comes with a padded storage case, allowing extra bits to be stored neatly when not in use.
